# See https://nextjs.org/learn-pages-router/seo/crawling-and-indexing/robots-txt for documentation on how to use the robots.txt file
#

User-Agent: *
Disallow: /search/users
Disallow: /*/search/users

Disallow: /search/plans
Disallow: /*/search/plans
Disallow: /usi/
Disallow: /aml/
Disallow: /as/
Disallow: /eo/
Disallow: /uz/

# Parallel reader: the 4-segment path (also covers /bible/*/*/notes) and the
# ?parallel= / &parallel= query.
Disallow: /bible/*/*/
Disallow: /*/bible/*/*/
Disallow: /*?parallel=
Disallow: /*&parallel=

# RSC payloads (`?_rsc=` / `&_rsc=`) from next/link prefetches.
Disallow: /*_rsc=
# Per-render session probe; always 401 for crawlers.
Disallow: /api/authenticate

# AionBot crawls heavily and has no known operator or search value. A crawler
# obeys only its most specific group, so this replaces the rules above for it.
User-Agent: AionBot
Disallow: /

# Epochal-Search crawls heavily (about 30% of origin compute on Nov 3–5, 2026)
# from Oracle Cloud and has no known operator or search value.
User-Agent: Epochal-Search
Disallow: /
